mapper.select: SELECT o.*, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, c.phone as c_phone, c.address as c_address, u.id as u_id, u.username as u_username, u.real_name as u_real_name FROM laundry_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, c.phone as c_phone, c.address as c_address, u.id as u_id, u.username as u_username, u.real_name as u_real_name, d.id as d_id, d.order_id as d_order_id, d.service_id as d_service_id, d.service_name as d_service_name, d.quantity as d_quantity, d.unit_price as d_unit_price, d.subtotal as d_subtotal, d.remark as d_remark FROM laundry_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN order_detail d ON o.id = d.order_id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, c.phone as c_phone, c.address as c_address, u.id as u_id, u.username as u_username, u.real_name as u_real_name FROM laundry_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT o.*, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, c.phone as c_phone, c.address as c_address, u.id as u_id, u.username as u_username, u.real_name as u_real_name FROM laundry_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laundry_order WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO laundry_order (order_no, customer_id, user_id, total_amount, status, receive_time, expect_time, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{receiveTime}, #{expectTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE laundry_order SET total_amount = #{totalAmount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(#{prefix}, LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(order_no, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 3, '0')) FROM laundry_order WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
